name: Salmon, Coriander & Miso Smash
notes:
Roast salmon and Tenderstem with miso, ginger and coriander. Mob's figures don't include bread for this one.

Ingredients (whole batch):
• 4 skinless salmon fillets
• ½ tbsp water
• 2 tbsp soy sauce
• 200g Tenderstem broccoli
• 15g fresh coriander
• 1 tbsp miso
• 1½ tbsp vinegar
• 1 tsp ginger paste

Method:
1. Heat the oven to 180°C.
2. Put the salmon on a tray with the water and half the soy sauce. Cook in the oven for 15 mins.
3. 4 mins before the salmon is done, add the broccoli to the tray. Meanwhile, finely chop the coriander.
4. Roughly chop the broccoli into bite-size pieces and flake the salmon with a fork.
5. Mix the miso, vinegar and ginger paste in a medium bowl.
6. Add the salmon, broccoli and coriander and mix to combine.
7. Smoosh over toast, pitta, a bagel or whatever you fancy.

Nutrition is Mob's figure per serving, as served in the recipe. Also per serving: saturated fat 7g, fibre 4g, sugars 2g, sodium 1790mg.

Source: https://www.mob.co.uk/recipes/salmon-coriander-miso-smoosh
